post.description: kind FULL (default): pay for a checkout; the intent stays PENDING until POST /orders uses it. kind DEPOSIT: pay the deposit of an accepted land reservation (`referenceId` is the reservation id, `amount` must equal its deposit); the mock gateway takes it at once, so `status` in the response is SUCCEEDED (or FAILED for the test amount) and the land service activates the reservation. BALANCE and REFUND are created by the order service.

403.description: The token does not have the required role

post.summary: Mock gateway: report the result of a payment intent
post.description: Called by the (mock) payment gateway, not by an app. Authenticated with the shared secret in the X-Webhook-Secret header. Settles a PENDING DEPOSIT intent; repeating the same result is harmless. Only needed when the deposit was not taken at once.

post.summary: Customer: choose delivery or buy-back for a graded harvest
post.description: The harvest order is created when the quality check passes (status PLACED, no option). DELIVERY needs `deliveryAddress` (and optionally `deliveryDate`): the order becomes READY_FOR_DISPATCH and is pooled like any order; the balance (total minus deposit) is charged when it is delivered. BUYBACK: the farmer buys the harvest, the customer is credited and the order is COMPLETED. Repeating the same choice returns the order.

post.summary: Checkout: place one order per farm
post.description: The cart lives in the app; its items are sent here. The Idempotency-Key header is required: repeating a request with the same key and body returns the first result instead of creating new orders. After a PAYMENT_FAILED (402) use a new key to retry.

OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus
OrderStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a per-farm order (HLD section 11).

PLACED -> CONFIRMED -> PACKED -> QC_PASSED -> READY_FOR_DISPATCH is issue #13. After that
logistics drives it: POOLED (pool assigned), IN_TRANSIT (picked up), DELIVERED, COMPLETED.

OrderType.title: OrderType
OrderType.description: PRODUCE is the V1 purchase of listed produce. HARVEST is added by the V2 harvest flow.

PaymentIntent.title: PaymentIntent
PaymentIntent.description:
A mock payment. In this project it always succeeds unless the amount is a test value.

A FULL intent stays PENDING until it is used by POST /orders. A DEPOSIT is taken as soon as the
intent is created, so `status` is already SUCCEEDED or FAILED in the response.

PaymentKind.title: PaymentKind
PaymentKind.description:
What a payment is for (HLD section 10). The land service pays reservation deposits through
this API too. BALANCE and REFUND rows are written by the order service, never requested by a
client.

PaymentRecord.title: PaymentRecord
PaymentRecord.description: A payment or refund that belongs to an order.

PaymentWebhook.title: PaymentWebhook
